snippet: The Absolute is named in full, then venerated by absorption into it; the name is lived, not glossed. Veneration is not offering but becoming.
text: the object is fixed in full all pervading vyapta particular of moving and unmoving states caracarabhavavisesa consisting of consciousness cinmaya one eka endless ananta beginningless anadi the act follows bhairava lord bhairavanatham refuge of the helpless anathasaranyam venerated by mind become yours tvanmayacittataya in heart hrdi vande i venerate veneration is not ritual offering but mental absorption the devotee s mind becoming his tvanmaya the name bhairava performs its own nirukta here bearing supporting the universe the roar rava of aham benefactor of the terrified all three senses lived in the single act of absorption tantraloka 1 95 100 total surrender is sized to its object the all pervading consciousness is venerated by absorption into it not by offering to it the absolute is named in full then venerated by absorption into it the name is lived not glossed veneration is not offering but becoming what is the object of veneration and how does veneration relate to it
